prior_knowledge.ecg_description: ECG (Electrocardiogram) measures the electrical activity of the heart. Normal ECG shows P wave (atrial depolarization), QRS complex (ventricular depolarization), and T wave (ventricular repolarization).

hrv_interpretation.high_hrv: Generally indicates good cardiovascular fitness and stress resilience
hrv_interpretation.low_hrv: May indicate stress, fatigue, or cardiovascular issues
hrv_interpretation.lf_hf_ratio: Higher ratio may indicate sympathetic dominance (stress); lower ratio indicates parasympathetic dominance (relaxation)

common_arrhythmias: Sinus Tachycardia: HR > 100 bpm at rest
Atrial Fibrillation: Irregular rhythm, no clear P waves
Ventricular Tachycardia: Wide QRS complexes, rapid rate
Premature Ventricular Contractions (PVCs): Early, wide QRS beats

stress_indicators.rmssd: Root Mean Square of Successive Differences - lower values indicate higher stress
stress_indicators.pnn50: % of successive RR intervals differing by >50ms - lower values indicate stress
stress_indicators.lf_power: Low frequency power (0.04-0.15 Hz) - reflects both sympathetic and parasympathetic activity
stress_indicators.hf_power: High frequency power (0.15-0.4 Hz) - reflects parasympathetic (vagal) activity
